body.p: To get started, edit the DITA sources under src/topics and update the map at src/maps/main.ditamap.
Build the documentation locally with the DITA-OT command line using the HTML5 and PDF targets.

section.title: Local build commands
section.p: Run these commands from the repository root:
section.codeblock: dita -i src/maps/main.ditamap -f html5 -o out/html dita -i src/maps/main.ditamap -f pdf2 -o out/pdf
